en: In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor a fetter … [and so on] … in dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor a tie … in dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor a flood … [and so on] … in dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor a bond … in dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor an hindrance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor cessation…
